name: svg-french-press-mistral-large-4-0-s2-r1
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a French press, as an SVG. Use the standard three-piece plunger filter rather than a two-piece travel press.

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1000" height="1220" viewBox="0 0 1000 1220">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="rodG" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#c9c9c9"/>
      <stop offset="0.35" stop-color="#f2f2f2"/>
      <stop offset="0.7" stop-color="#9a9a9a"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#c2c2c2"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="knobG" cx="0.35" cy="0.3" r="0.95">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#6e6e6e"/>
      <stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#2f2f2f"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#101010"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="plateG" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f8f8f8"/>
      <stop offset="0.6" stop-color="#d6d6d6"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#a9a9a9"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="glassG" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#e2f2fa" stop-opacity="0.55"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#b9d9e8" stop-opacity="0.55"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <pattern id="mesh" width="5" height="5" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <rect width="5" height="5" fill="#e4e4e4"/>
      <path d="M0,0 H5 M0,0 V5" stroke="#8a8a8a" stroke-width="0.7" fill="none"/>
    </pattern>
    <pattern id="perf" width="19" height="11" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <circle cx="9.5" cy="5.5" rx="4.2" ry="2.4" fill="#6f6f6f"/>
    </pattern>
  </defs>

  <rect width="1000" height="1220" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <g font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
    <text x="500" y="46" text-anchor="middle" font-size="30" font-weight="700" fill="#1a1a1a">French Press — Exploded Assembly</text>
    <text x="500" y="72" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" fill="#777">Three-piece plunger filter: cross plate · mesh · coil spring</text>
  </g>

  <!-- assembly axis -->
  <line x1="380" y1="95" x2="380" y2="1135" stroke="#b5b5b5" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="10 8"/>

  <!-- 1 · knob -->
  <g>
    <path d="M336,118 A44,13 0 0 0 424,118 C424,148 408,162 380,162 C352,162 336,148 336,118 Z" fill="url(#knobG)"/>
    <ellipse cx="380" cy="118" rx="44" ry="13" fill="#454545"/>
    <ellipse cx="371" cy="115" rx="24" ry="6.5" fill="#8a8a8a" opacity="0.45"/>
    <rect x="371" y="158" width="18" height="14" rx="3" fill="url(#rodG)" stroke="#8a8a8a" stroke-width="0.75"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 2 · plunger rod -->
  <g>
    <rect x="376" y="172" width="8" height="393" fill="url(#rodG)" stroke="#8f8f8f" stroke-width="0.75"/>
    <line x1="378" y1="176" x2="378" y2="560" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.5"/>
    <rect x="373.5" y="500" width="13" height="58" rx="2" fill="url(#rodG)" stroke="#8f8f8f" stroke-width="0.75"/>
    <path d="M374,508 h12 M374,516 h12 M374,524 h12 M374,532 h12 M374,540 h12 M374,548 h12 M374,556 h12" stroke="#7c7c7c" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 3 · cross plate (perforated) -->
  <g>
    <path d="M262,605 L262,619 A118,20 0 0 0 498,619 L498,605 Z" fill="#a6a6a6"/>
    <ellipse cx="380" cy="605" rx="118" ry="20" fill="url(#plateG)"/>
    <ellipse cx="380" cy="605" rx="118" ry="20" fill="url(#perf)"/>
    <ellipse cx="380" cy="605" rx="118" ry="20" fill="none" stroke="#8a8a8a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="380" cy="605" rx="104" ry="17" fill="none" stroke="#bdbdbd" stroke-width="1"/>
    <ellipse cx="380" cy="605" rx="13" ry="4.5" fill="#8f8f8f" stroke="#6f6f6f" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 4 · mesh filter -->
  <g>
    <path d="M260,695 L260,701 A120,20 0 0 0 500,701 L500,695 Z" fill="#adadad"/>
    <ellipse cx="380" cy="695" rx="120" ry="20" fill="url(#mesh)"/>
    <ellipse cx="380" cy="695" rx="120" ry="20" fill="none" stroke="#8f8f8f" stroke-width="3"/>
    <ellipse cx="380" cy="695" rx="111" ry="17.5" fill="none" stroke="#9a9a9a" stroke-width="1"/>
    <ellipse cx="380" cy="695" rx="10" ry="3.5" fill="#cfcfcf" stroke="#8a8a8a" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 5 · coil spring disc -->
  <g>
    <path d="M260,775 L260,785 A120,20 0 0 0 500,785 L500,775 Z" fill="#9e9e9e"/>
    <ellipse cx="380" cy="775" rx="120" ry="20" fill="#c6c6c6" stroke="#8a8a8a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <g fill="none" stroke="#7b7b7b" stroke-width="3">
      <ellipse cx="380" cy="775" rx="102" ry="17"/>
      <ellipse cx="380" cy="775" rx="84" ry="14"/>
      <ellipse cx="380" cy="775" rx="66" ry="11"/>
      <ellipse cx="380" cy="775" rx="48" ry="8"/>
      <ellipse cx="380" cy="775" rx="30" ry="5"/>
    </g>
    <ellipse cx="380" cy="775" rx="12" ry="2.5" fill="#8a8a8a"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 6 · lid -->
  <g>
    <path d="M244,845 L244,851 A136,18 0 0 0 516,851 L516,845 Z" fill="#a6a6a6"/>
    <ellipse cx="380" cy="845" rx="136" ry="18" fill="url(#plateG)" stroke="#8a8a8a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="380" cy="845" rx="10" ry="3.5" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#8a8a8a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 7 · carafe -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx="380" cy="1116" rx="138" ry="10" fill="#000000" opacity="0.07"/>
    <path d="M244,905 C242,972 248,1042 258,1083 L502,1083 C512,1042 518,972 516,905 A136,18 0 0 1 244,905 Z" fill="url(#glassG)" stroke="#7fa8bd" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <path d="M258,1083 L502,1083 L501,1101 A121,12 0 0 1 259,1101 Z" fill="#a9cfe0" opacity="0.65" stroke="#7fa8bd" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="380" cy="905" rx="136" ry="18" fill="#dceef7" opacity="0.5" stroke="#7fa8bd" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="380" cy="905" rx="120" ry="13" fill="#f2fafd" opacity="0.95" stroke="#9cc0d2" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <path d="M248,900 Q236,896 227,887 Q242,889 254,894 Z" fill="#cfe6f2" opacity="0.75" stroke="#7fa8bd" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <path d="M514,939 C577,937 593,965 593,996 C593,1027 577,1055 512,1053" fill="none" stroke="#9fc3d4" stroke-width="15" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.85"/>
    <path d="M514,939 C577,937 593,965 593,996 C593,1027 577,1055 512,1053" fill="none" stroke="#dceef7" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>
    <line x1="270" y1="935" x2="274" y2="1060" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.35"/>
    <line x1="286" y1="950" x2="288" y2="1045" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.3"/>
  </g>

  <!-- labels -->
  <g font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
    <g stroke="#9a9a9a" stroke-width="1.2">
      <line x1="428" y1="135" x2="656" y2="135"/>
      <line x1="386" y1="350" x2="656" y2="350"/>
      <line x1="500" y1="605" x2="656" y2="605"/>
      <line x1="502" y1="695" x2="656" y2="695"/>
      <line x1="502" y1="775" x2="656" y2="775"/>
      <line x1="518" y1="845" x2="656" y2="845"/>
      <line x1="598" y1="985" x2="656" y2="985"/>
    </g>
    <g fill="#9a9a9a">
      <circle cx="428" cy="135" r="3"/>
      <circle cx="386" cy="350" r="3"/>
      <circle cx="500" cy="605" r="3"/>
      <circle cx="502" cy="695" r="3"/>
      <circle cx="502" cy="775" r="3"/>
      <circle cx="518" cy="845" r="3"/>
      <circle cx="598" cy="985" r="3"/>
    </g>
    <g fill="#3d3d3d">
      <circle cx="672" cy="135" r="13"/>
      <circle cx="672" cy="350" r="13"/>
      <circle cx="672" cy="605" r="13"/>
      <circle cx="672" cy="695" r="13"/>
      <circle cx="672" cy="775" r="13"/>
      <circle cx="672" cy="845" r="13"/>
      <circle cx="672" cy="985" r="13"/>
    </g>
    <g font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">
      <text x="672" y="140">1</text>
      <text x="672" y="355">2</text>
      <text x="672" y="610">3</text>
      <text x="672" y="700">4</text>
      <text x="672" y="780">5</text>
      <text x="672" y="850">6</text>
      <text x="672" y="990">7</text>
    </g>
    <g font-size="21" font-weight="600" fill="#222222">
      <text x="694" y="141">Knob</text>
      <text x="694" y="356">Plunger rod</text>
      <text x="694" y="611">Cross plate</text>
      <text x="694" y="701">Mesh filter</text>
      <text x="694" y="781">Coil spring</text>
      <text x="694" y="851">Lid</text>
      <text x="694" y="991">Carafe</text>
    </g>
    <g font-size="15" fill="#777777">
      <text x="694" y="161">heat-insulated handle</text>
      <text x="694" y="376">stainless steel</text>
      <text x="694" y="631">perforated disc</text>
      <text x="694" y="721">fine stainless mesh</text>
      <text x="694" y="801">retains mesh & plate</text>
      <text x="694" y="871">fits carafe mouth</text>
      <text x="694" y="1011">borosilicate glass</text>
    </g>
    <text x="40" y="1160" font-size="13" fill="#999999">dashed line = assembly axis</text>
  </g>
</svg>
